mediaFiles.keepSubtitlesInfo: Keep external subtitles in every language. Single files are delivered unchanged, including embedded subtitles. When merging parts, this setting also controls embedded subtitles.

ingest.generateTranscodesInfo: Off by default. When enabled, ingest asks Stash to generate full video transcodes when needed, which may use more processing time and disk space. Covers, previews, timeline sprites, and pHash are generated regardless.
ingest.transferInfo: Moji filters and deduplicates downloaded files, delivers single movies in their original format, and merges parts into MKV before asking Stash to scan.
ingest.qbRootInfo: The download root from qBittorrent's perspective. Moji makes the task save path relative to this root.
ingest.mojiDownloadInfo: The download root from Moji's perspective. The relative qB save directory is appended here to locate selected source files.
ingest.mojiLibraryInfo: The media root from Moji's perspective. Movies are written in a code directory, retaining the original extension for single files or using MKV for merged parts.
ingest.stashInfo: The media root from Stash's perspective. It must expose the same files as the Moji library root. Stash scans the code directory under this root.
ingest.actionInfo: Copy retains downloaded sources. Move stops the qB task and removes selected sources after the full movie and subtitles are delivered. Neither overwrites another task's or a user's existing movie.

policy.summary: Solo: {{solo}}; 2–{{max}} performers: {{group}}; compilation: {{compilation}}; release range: {{range}}; ambiguous classifications or dates are recorded for review.

automationUi.processingHelp: Update download progress and organize completed downloads for Stash. Changes take effect when saved.
automationUi.processingOffHelp: Saving will pause progress updates and automatic imports. Downloads and work already started may continue.
automationUi.intervalHelp: How often Moji checks tasks. Shorter intervals update progress and start imports sooner, without changing download speed.
automationUi.pausedDetail: Download progress will stop updating, and completed downloads will not be added to Stash automatically. Downloads and work already started may continue. Resource searches and subscription checks are unaffected.
automationUi.soloInfo: Applies when the scene has one performer.
automationUi.groupInfo: Applies to scenes with 2 through N performers, and larger scenes that do not match the compilation rule.
automationUi.compilationInfo: Compilation classification takes precedence and uses title, details, tags, and unusually large casts.
automationUi.groupMaxInfo: Group means 2 through N performers; larger scenes remain group scenes unless identified as compilations.
automationUi.dateRangeInfo: Only applies when the policy would download. Older or undated releases are recorded for review.
